source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the receptors of smell (PDF 44-45).

blocks.text: Naak ki cavities (khanon) ke oopri hisse mein maujood chemoreceptors soonghne ki hiss (olfaction) ke zimmedar hain. Yeh receptors asal mein sensory neurons ke sire hain. Yeh sensory neurons ek patli teh mein hote hain jise nasal epithelium kehte hain. Yeh do aur qisam ke cells ke darmiyan kas kar bhare hote hain: supporting cells, jo hifazat karte hain, aur basal cells, jo stem cells ka kaam kar ke purane neurons ki jagah naye banate hain.

In sensory neurons ke dendrites (paigham lene wale sire) par nanhe baal jaise hisse hote hain jinhein cilia kehte hain. Yeh cilia naak ki cavity ki andaruni geeli mucus (balgham) mein bahar ki taraf nikle hote hain. Jab hawa naak mein aati hai to hawa ke kimiyai madde mucus mein ghul jate hain. Yeh ghule hue madde cilia par khaas receptor jagahon se jur jate hain. Is jurne se sensory neurons mein nerve impulse banta hai jo olfactory nerves (cranial nerve I) ke zariye olfactory bulb tak jata hai. Kitab ke mutabiq olfactory bulb boo ka ehsas paida karta hai.

blocks.alt: Kata hua sar jis mein naak ki cavity ki chhat par nasal epithelium nishan zada hai, aur us ki bari tasveer: support cells ke darmiyan sensory neurons se olfactory nerve ke axons oopar jate hain, saath basal cells ki qataar hai; dendrites mucus mein cilia par khatam hote hain jahan boo ke molecules (odour molecules) hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle sar ke kate hue manzar mein naak ki chhat par nasal epithelium dhoondein, phir us ki bari tasveer dekhein: neeche mucus mein boo ke molecules cilia se jurte hain, sensory neurons support cells ke darmiyan hain, basal cells naye neurons banate hain, aur oopar olfactory nerve ke axons paigham le jate hain.

blocks.title: Matan ke baare mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai olfactory bulb boo ka ehsas paida karta hai. Asal mein bulb signals ko process kar ke aage bhejta hai; boo ka shaoori ehsas cerebrum ke olfactory cortex mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Jo madda naak ki mucus mein na ghule us ki boo kyun nahin aati?
blocks.explanation: Boo ke maddon ko cilia ki receptor jagahon tak pohanch kar jurne ke liye mucus mein ghulna zaroori hai; jurne ke baghair impulse nahin banta.

items: Boo: nasal epithelium mein sensory neurons ke sire; mucus mein ghule madde cilia se jurte hain; impulse cranial nerve I se olfactory bulb tak; basal cells purane neurons badalte hain.
